title: Add --debug option
description:
To help with customer support, this PR adds a `--debug` option to log the following info:

- path of loaded config files
- command line arguments
- filename and filemode (added, removed, modified) of scanned documents
- sha of scanned commits
- scan exit code

comments.author: agateau-gg
comments.body:
> I just have one minor remark : while testing the `--debug` option, we should note that we will catch logs from other libs. For instance `urllib3`. I don't know if this can have an impact in terms of volume of logs for instance.

I think it should not matter to end users: unless they want to debug a problem themselves, the log output is just some content they can copy-and-paste to us. The fact that urllib3 logs are included is a detail.

Using `--debug` should imply that the app is going to become much more chatty, but the libraries we use do not to flood the output.
